_readme: Sample answer file for fdr-nsx-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.
Deployment uses custom vCenter placement. Appliance identity and IP configuration remain those in the existing extracted SDDC data.
Each cmdlet key contains one answer set for its single invocation in this plan.
New-NSXManagerOvaDeployment answers: NSX Manager ID. Invoke-NSXManagerRestore answers: the same NSX Manager ID, then backup ID.
The sample selects manager 1 and backup 1. Review the discovered IDs and backup timestamp interactively before using these answers.
Omit a cmdlet key to answer its prompts manually. A supplied key with missing or invalid answers fails the run.
